description: Reviewed cardiacFoam allowlist for the approximate C++ dictionary-key scanner. RENAMED 2026-08-25: the former 'absent_keys' bucket is now 'unmatched_cxx_reads', and the scanner comparison was fixed at the same time. The old name asserted something untrue -- that the catalog was MISSING these keys -- when 59 of the 83 entries (71%) were catalogued all along and merely invisible to the comparison: 26 were container/parent segments (outputVariables, singleCellStimulus, bathPotentialDomain, ...) that the check never consulted, and 33 were leaves of dynamic wildcard paths (sigmaExtracellular under ecgDomains.<name>, graphFile and purkinjeConductivity under conductionNetworkDomains.<name>, ...) which were excluded from the leaf set because that same set also feeds stale_paths, where excluding wildcards IS correct. compute_dict_key_drift now builds two views: cat_leaves (concrete only, for stale_paths) and catalogued_names (all leaves plus parent segments, for unmatched_cxx_reads). Waiver count 83 -> 24. The 24 that remain are permanent and expected, in four groups. (a) NOT THIS CATALOG'S DICT FILE: 'TaScale', 'Tmax', 'V0', 'amplitude', 'gamma', 'initializeFields', 'xMin', 'xMax', 'electroMechanicalModel', 'electromechanicalVerificationModel' belong to electroMechanicalProperties or the MMS verifiers, not to electroProperties; 'points', 'rootNode', 'pvjNodes', 'pvjLocations', 'pvjResistances' are read from constant/<graphFile> (e.g. constant/purkinjeGraph), a machine-generated file driverFOAM never writes -- it only references it by the already-catalogued graphFile key. (b) UPSTREAM OPENFOAM'S KEY: 'nNonOrthogonalCorrectors' is read from a pimpleDict (extracellularPotentialDomain.C:55). OpenFOAM owns that contract; cataloguing it here would be claiming someone else's key. 'ODESolver' likewise. (c) NOT A DICTIONARY KEY AT ALL: 'Vm' and 'Iion' are field names in string comparisons and IOobject names (conductionSystemDomain.C:403,410); 'endocardialCells', 'mCells', 'epicardialCells' are tissue VALUES in tissues.found(...) membership tests (configuredBatchedIonicModel.H:155-157); 'global' is an ionicConstantOverrides <scope> value, not a literal path segment. (d) DEAD CODE: 'torsoSurface' is a genuine dict.get<fileName> read in ecgModelIO::loadSurface, but that function is declared and defined and never called anywhere in src/. Verified 2026-08-25. If loadSurface is ever wired up, torsoSurface becomes a real catalog gap and this waiver must be removed. The 10 stale_paths remain scanner BLIND SPOTS, not catalog bugs -- the regex cannot follow dimensioned<T>(name, dict) constructors, spec.dictionaryEntry struct indirection, or dictionaries handed to upstream OpenFOAM (ODESolver::New reads solver/absTol/relTol/maxSteps flat from the coeffs dict, exactly as catalogued).
